salient_findings: Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, submucosal mass on the right buccal mucosa
key_facts: 30-year-old woman
2-month history of swelling in the right cheek
Severe pain associated with the swelling
Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass
Mass located on the right buccal mucosa
Smooth mucosal surface without color change
Ultrasonography showed a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches clinical description of a mobile, submucosal mass with smooth mucosal surface

shortlist.label: Ectopic lymph node
shortlist.why_kept: Considered in differential diagnosis based on clinical and radiographic findings

shortlist.label: Mucocele
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of a submucosal mass with smooth surface, although less likely given ultrasonography results

shortlist.label: Salivary gland tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Could present as a submucosal mass in the cheek region, although less common

shortlist.label: Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion, although less likely given patient's age and symptoms

raw.rationale: The presence of a solitary, mobile, submucosal mass with ill-defined borders and a smooth mucosal surface, along with severe pain and a well-defined hypoechoic lesion on ultrasonography, is more consistent with an ectopic lymph node, which can present as a painful, mobile mass.

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipomas are typically painless and have well-defined borders.

rejected.label: Mucocele
rejected.why: Mucoceles usually present with a history of trauma and have a characteristic bluish color due to the mucin content.

rejected.label: Salivary gland tumor
rejected.why: Salivary gland tumors can be painful but are less likely to be mobile and have a smooth mucosal surface.

rejected.label: Hemangioma
rejected.why: Hemangiomas often have a bluish discoloration and may have a history of trauma or sudden growth, which is not mentioned in the case.
